mapper.select:
select distinct PFI, FACILITY_NAME from NBS_FACILITY_MONITORING where FACILITY_NAME is not null
and PFI = #{FACILITY_NAME}
and ((BIRTHQTR = #{birthFirstQuarter} and BIRTHYR = #{birthFirstYear}) or (BIRTHQTR = #{birthSecondQuarter} and BIRTHYR = #{birthSecondYear}))
order by FACILITY_NAME asc

select min(REPORT_FROM_DATE) from_date, max(REPORT_TO_DATE) to_date from NBS_FACILITY_MONITORING where FACILITY_NAME is not null
and ((BIRTHQTR = #{birthFirstQuarter} and BIRTHYR = #{birthFirstYear}) or (BIRTHQTR = #{birthSecondQuarter} and BIRTHYR = #{birthSecondYear})) order by BIRTHYR asc, BIRTHQTR asc

select to_char((round(sum(TESTED_PRENATALLY_PERCENT )/count(TOTAL_SPECIMEN), 0))) PRENATAL_PERCENTAGE, to_char((round(sum(SEC_PRENATAL_DONE_PERCENT )/count(TOTAL_SPECIMEN), 0))) SEC_PRENATAL_PERCENTAGE from NBS_FACILITY_MONITORING where ((BIRTHQTR = #{birthFirstQuarter} and BIRTHYR = #{birthFirstYear}) or (BIRTHQTR = #{birthSecondQuarter} and BIRTHYR = #{birthSecondYear}))
select nbs.*, Trim(To_Char(sysdate, 'Month')) || ' ' || To_Char(sysdate,'dd, yyyy') TODAY_DATE from CODED_NBS_HIV_DESIGNEES nbs where pfi = to_number(#{pfi})
select * from CODED_NBS_PFI_NAMES where pfi = to_number(#{pfi})
select pfi, facility_name, sex, labid, birthdt, medrecno from nbs_facility_demographics where pfi = #{PFI} and BIRTHQTR = #{BIRTHQTR} and BIRTHYR = #{BIRTHYR}
